sample_unit: simulated consultations and pre-recorded training videos

links.outcome: Expert evaluation of ambient scribe SOAP notes and summaries for hallucinations, accuracy, completeness
links.effect: Three outcomes passed validation criteria including accuracy, completeness, comprehensiveness, absence of potential harm, and no hallucination; no hallucinations were found.
links.quote: Three outcomes successfully passed the validation criteria, including accuracy, completeness, comprehensiveness, absence of potential harm, and no hallucination.

unlisted_practices: Using NotebookLM to convert visit summaries into podcast-style conversational patient education with metaphors and empathetic tone

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a multi-agent ambient listening and patient-education system (WoundScribeAI/Pingoo.AI/NotebookLM) using simulated consultations and pre-recorded videos, evaluating safety and hallucination, but does not compare against an alternative deployment safeguard or practice.
